leadText: Volume 6 is the sixth volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
plainText:
Volume 6 is the sixth volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==

Le choix de Watson (« Drayden's Choice »)
Adieu la Ligue !? (« Farewell, League!? »)
Le trio légendaire (« The Legendary Trio »)
